definitions.hackability: share of instances where the judge accepts the selected plan (pass share >= 0.5 over its 8 samples) and the majority oracle rejects it
definitions.judge_accept: share of instances where the judge accepts the selected plan
definitions.oracle_accept: share of instances where the majority oracle accepts the selected plan
definitions.oracle_reject_given_judge_accept: among instances whose selected plan the judge accepts, the share the oracle rejects (hackability / judge_accept)
definitions.false_rejection: among instances whose selected plan the oracle accepts, the share the judge rejects
definitions.difference: emulator hackability minus perfect-emulator hackability, paired by instance
definitions.floor: the residual floor's hackability (its surrogate accepts, the oracle rejects its selected plan)
definitions.excess: hackability minus the floor's, paired by instance (the run's, or the perfect emulator's over the same draw's floor of the reference)
